violations.text: The first-floor bar was observed to be missing a hand wash sink (currently using a bay of the 3-bay sink as dish washing. A dedicated hand sink is to be installed. Per the PIC, hand sink is available for installation. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The hand sink in the main kitchen area was observed to be not easily accessible to all cookline at time of need. Per the PIC, arrangement of cookline coolers to be adjusted for ease of access. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Call was made for service at time of inspection. Technician arrived and properly repaired/adjusted unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026

All food items stored in the walk-in cooler were observed at 51-53 degrees Fahrenheit at the time of inspection. Food items were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC and employees at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026

The following equipment was observed in need of repair/adjustment: - The salad prep unit was observed to have torn/ripped gaskets - The walk-in cooler was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 46-54 degrees Fahrenheit with food temps observed at 50-53 degrees Fahrenheit. Use of prepared foods walk-in cooler is discontinued until service/repaired and properly maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. Call was made for service to arrive same day. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026
Insufficient lighting observed in the lower level kitchen area. Establishment shall replace bulbs. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/03/2025

The ceiling in the downstairs kitchen, main food prep area, and ceiling in the upstairs bar area are covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. -Ceiling shall be replaced. -In addition, the floor in the upstairs bar area is not smooth, durable, non-absorbent, or easily cleanable. Floor shall be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 02/25/2025

Lighting in the downstairs kitchen observed inadequate. Lighting 6-303.11 Intensity. The light intensity shall be: (A) At least 108 lux (10 foot candles) at a distance of 75 cm (30 inches) above the floor, in walk-in refrigeration units and dry FOOD storage areas and in other areas and rooms during periods of cleaning. -Brighter lights shall be installed. New Violation. Correct By: 02/25/2025
